reason.id: Darwin VAAC telah menghentikan advisori—abu tidak lagi teridentifikasi; tidak ada VONA/erupsi baru dari MAGMA.
reason.en: Darwin VAAC has terminated its advisory—ash no longer identifiable; no fresh VONA/eruption from MAGMA.

report.author: Rioboniek Situmorang
report.visual: Gunung api tertutup Kabut 0-III. Asap kawah tidak teramati. Cuaca berawan, angin lemah ke arah barat laut.
report.climate: Cuaca berawan, angin lemah ke arah barat laut. Suhu udara sekitar 26.4-26.7°C. Kelembaban 84-87%.
report.recommendation: Masyarakat/pengunjung/wisatawan/pendaki tidak mendekati G. Anak Krakatau atau beraktivitas dalam radius 3 km dari kawah aktif.

vona.text: Eruption at 0434 UTC (1134 local). Ash-cloud is not observed. Ash-cloud is not observed..
Eruption at 0200 UTC (0900 local). Ash-cloud is not observed. Ash-cloud is not observed..

Eruption with volcanic ash cloud at 0824 UTC (1524 local). Best estimate of ash-cloud top is around 1782 FT (557 M) above sea level or 1280 FT (400 M) above summit. May be higher than what can be observed clearly. Source of height data: ground observer. Ash cloud moving from north to northeast. Volcanic ash is observed to be gray to dark. The intensity of volcanic ash is observed to be thick..
